$comment: Differences between the legacy reader (parse-legacy.ts) and the new reader (lower.ts) that reader-differential.corpus.test.ts accepts. Entries name one line; classes name a kind of difference, each checked by the suite's own verifier, with per-file counts in reader-differential.md.

entries.old: typed rule, output raw `fix`, the `''` dropped
entries.reason: Keyman-19 removed statement; old reader dropped the `''` (research R1, finding 4); the grammar rejects the line

entries.old: typed rule, output raw `fix`, the `''` dropped
entries.reason: Keyman-19 removed statement; old reader dropped the `''` (research R1, finding 4); the grammar rejects the line

entries.new: grammar rejects the line; the legacy line reader keeps fragment if-option-store
entries.reason: The Keyman grammar has no `<>` comparison; contracts/lowering.md keeps `<>` as if-option-store

entries.new: grammar rejects the line; the legacy line reader keeps the typed rule
entries.reason: The Keyman grammar has no NUMLOCK modifier; the legacy line reader keeps the key raw as before

entries.new: grammar rejects the line; the legacy line reader keeps the typed rule
entries.reason: The Keyman grammar has no NUMLOCK modifier; the legacy line reader keeps the key raw as before

classes.new: typed rule or store with the supplementary-plane character
classes.reason: The Keyman lexer reads `U+XXXXX` above U+FFFF as a character (contracts/lowering.md §3); smp-literal is retained only for persisted drafts

classes.old: a call written with whitespace before its `(` (`any (x)`, `index (s, 2)`) split into two raw elements
classes.reason: kmcmplib accepts whitespace between a keyword and its `(`; the legacy splitTokens cut the token at the space

classes.old: calls written with no space between them (`any(a)any(b)`, `index(a,2)index(b,3)`) kept as one raw element
classes.reason: kmcmplib lexes each call separately; the legacy splitTokens kept a glued paren run as one token
